name: @fieldseal/prisma
description: EXPERIMENTAL, NOT INDEPENDENTLY REVIEWED, NOT FOR PRODUCTION DATA; format may change before 1.0, data may need re-encrypting. Encrypted Prisma model fields that you can still query by equality.
//: AD-1 (spec §11.3): zero cryptography in this package. The only calls into
@fieldseal/core are its published operations plus warm(), and the only
reason any cipher exists in this tree is transitively, through the core.
A direct crypto dependency here is a conformance failure, not a style
question -- CI asserts it rather than trusting review.
overrides: the prisma CLI (7.9.1, 7.10.0) pins mysql2 3.15.3 exactly,
which has GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr (auth downgrade to mysql_clear_password).
It was never reachable here: no schema in this repository uses a MySQL
mysql2 is dev-only in this package. npm honours `overrides` in the root
project only, so this field constrains nothing for anyone who installs
@fieldseal/prisma, although release staging copies it into the
published package.json, where it is inert.
The override is a floor on an unexercised dependency, not a tested
configuration -- nothing in CI runs MySQL, so the 3.15.3 -> 3.24.4 jump
is untested. Drop it when prisma stops depending on mysql2 (8.x already
has) or pins a mysql2 at or above 3.22.0. CI asserts the floor in both
